prompt:
Using the provided reference image as a loose layout reference, replace the prompt-library interface with a clean 3-column by 3-row gallery of exactly 9 vertical retro graphic posters. Remove all website UI elements, author names, buttons, borders, Korean interface text, and card metadata. Keep only the idea of a tiled poster grid with narrow gutters on an off-white background.

Style: Bold 1960s–1970s modernist poster design, flat vector shapes, cream paper backgrounds, high-contrast black typography, saturated primary colors, simple geometric compositions, minimal texture, crisp print-poster look.

Create exactly 9 posters, arranged left to right, top to bottom:
1. Poster text: “Travel Farther” — radiating perspective road/fields leading to a yellow sun.
2. Poster text: “CREATE” — large rounded blue psychedelic type above flowing wavy color bands.
3. Poster text: “GROW TOGETHER” — abstract flower with orange sun/circle and layered leaves.
4. Poster text: “LISTEN MORE” — overlapping side-profile silhouettes in black, blue, orange, and cream.
5. Poster text: “FIND YOUR BALANCE” — stacked semicircles and circles in yellow, pink, blue, black, and orange.
6. Poster text: “DRINK MORE WATER” — oversized white block type on a solid blue field with a small orange circle.
7. Poster text: “LEARN SOMETHING NEW” — geometric staircase entering an archway.
8. Poster text: “SEE THE BEAUTY” — halftone illustrated eye over transparent colored circles.
9. Poster text: “CHOOSE KINDNESS” — abstract geometric collage with a pink heart and colorful blocks.

Typography: Use bold condensed sans-serif headline lettering; make the text large, readable, and integrated into each poster. Use the headline set uplifting lifestyle reminders while preserving the exact 9-poster count and grid structure. Use a palette based on cream, black, yellow, orange-red, cobalt blue, forest green, and pink. Overall composition should feel like 1970s modernist motivational print posters.
